parent_qualification.scope: Two source-exposed real-world native projects, 20 subset worlds, 272 ordered unions, Lean checked; G2/G4 UNKNOWN

prior_role_authority.selection_disclosure: Reuse exactly the THREE previously metadata-frozen yet source-unopened training candidates AFTER the already-exposed Werkzeug and Click. This is a separate new prospective trial; never recode original pool as fresh.

eligibility: From frozen order choose FIRST original author-test modified/new AST node with an actual independently executed protected native failure, zero native error or skip and unchanged original production. Source test import apparatus UNKNOWN, not a legitimate failure; go next in frozen order only when no eligible genuine failure. Stop after first eligible regardless of outcome; all later source bodies unopened.
scoped_adapter: New versioned, explicitly engineer-supplied SOURCE-NEUTRAL metadata/test import source observer precommitted before opening target: exact original changed production plus at most seven original Git tracked Python files imported by HEAD author test. File roots src/ or project package original; full source/test byte attestation, refuse symlinks or ambiguous modules.
frozen_operator: Mistral qualified strict_terminal_anchor AST edit only. Unchanged prepare_candidates()/compose(), no new syntax family or target-specific edits. At most FOUR nonoverlapping primitive candidates across all admitted source files: if over 4 stop UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE_CAP rather than outcome-based truncate; if 0 REJECTED_METHOD_INAPPLICABLE.
native_protocol: Original base checkout + exact original contributor HEAD author test overlay only. Python3.12, preexisting frozen source-owned test deps and pytest 9.1.1. Mechanically changed TEST_*/test_* nodes selected BEFORE native oracle and test bodies only after immutable freeze. Actual per-parametrization JUnit case identities stable across all masks. Candidate mask/source schedule SHA fixed BEFORE candidate-native runs.
acceptance: Run all 2^k actual original native source masks (k<=4, total<=16); k>0, original has protected FAIL(s), no ERROR/SKIP/XFAIL/deselection; case-set identical. Validate for all ordered A,B that P(A union B) equals P(A) union P(B), and each edit selected in minimum PASS mask necessary. Repeat final protected PASS twice, unchanged full author suite PASS, physical all-source withdrawal exact original FAIL and byte restoration PASS, no source/test tampering. A failure of join is REJECTED_FINITE_JOIN_ON_THIRD_SOURCE; inapplicable method is REJECTED_METHOD_INAPPLICABLE. Neither can be retrospectively repaired within this freeze.

arms.A: Frozen one-primitive baseline: same original source, identical candidate set and native oracle; only singleton edits. Account each real native invocation and wall.
arms.B: Frozen finite-composition selector from Mistral/Deer: same source, candidates and observed native vectors; any advantage requires genuine native causal gain not possible in A.
arms.C: FULLY INFORMED EXECUTABLE LEDGER, never a handicapped dummy: receives same original author tests, all source/candidates, and can exhaust all admitted ≤16 native masks within matched oracle budget, choosing the minimum edit-count passing subset with deterministic lexicographic tie-break. All native lookups CHARGED; no outcome-for-free. If ledger finds same mask, report TIE.
arms.D: Actual competent tool-using coding agent if available with same source/test/verification access and cost budget. If not run, comparative G4 UNKNOWN; never claim B uniquely superior.
arms.physical: Withdraw B's selected original source edits and all dependent warrant, native protected failing cases must reappear, restore exact source bytes and PASS again.
arms.costs: Charge original setup, metadata, candidates, every native oracle call, full author suite, withdrawal and restoration, attempts, wall, cold restart if performed; do not claim cost/agent advantage without fully measured arms.

science.G2: UNKNOWN until independent real future source-native warrant and original method transfer, conditioned on frozen operation language; this alone is not unrestricted self-improvement
science.G4: UNKNOWN until ledger AND competent actual coding agent with full costs, tie means no unique advantage
science.Lean: Finite preexisting law cannot be assumed on new source; check all actual third-source masks and only then optional kernel proof; nonjoin witness is valid negative

security: No upstream writes, no production mutation; source-owned external tests run without GitHub token or user credentials; only isolated owner research branch updates.
stop: No original source/test/PR patch reads BEFORE this frozen commit. First eligible task only. No new source replacement based on outcome, no grammar expansion after target inspection. All previous RED/UNKNOWN retained.
